participant_id.Description: sub-<PennEPI id>: the PennEPI research identifier used by the deposit (folders raw_data/edf/PennEPIxxxxx).

recording_type.Description: Recording modality class from clinical meta (e.g. Scalp, SEEG)

length_of_stay_days.Description: Length of stay in the hospital

length_of_enrollment_days.Description: Length of enrollment in the study

num_push.Description: Number of patient self-reported push button notifications

num_push_after_enroll.Description: Number of patient self-reported push button notifications after enrollment

num_annots.Description: Number of annotations collected prospectively through the patient-AI platform

num_yes_annots.Description: Number of yes (seizure) annotations collected prospectively through the patient-AI platform

num_no_annots.Description: Number of no (non-seizure) annotations collected prospectively through the patient-AI platform

num_uncertain_annots.Description: Number of uncertain annotations collected prospectively through the patient-AI platform

surveys_enabled.Description: Whether Survey function was enabled for the participant

seizure_monitoring_enabled.Description: Whether seizures monitoring function was enabled for the participant

sleep_monitoring_enabled.Description: Whether sleep monitoring function was enabled for the participant

data_agent_enabled.Description: Whether data agent function was enabled for the participant

spike_monitoring_enabled.Description: Whether spikes monitoring function was enabled for the participant

home_asms.Description: Home antiseizure medication (ASMs) (free text; a calendar date in one entry was reduced to month/01)

bids_datatype.Description: BIDS datatype of this subject's recordings (from recording_type)

pennepi_release.Description: Public single-subject PennEPI Pennsieve release of the same patient, if any (checked against all 104 PennEPI releases, 2026-10-08). It contains a different recording (intracranial monitoring), not the EEG of this dataset.
